title.zh: 矩阵 · 把整个平面搬走

description.zh: 一个 2×2 矩阵只需说清两根基向量 (1, 0) 和 (0, 1) 各去了哪里（就是它的两列），平面上每个点、整张网格就都跟着确定；先做 A 再做 B 写作 BA，一般 AB ≠ BA，顺序会改变结果。
description.en: A 2×2 matrix only has to say where the two basis vectors (1, 0) and (0, 1) go — its two columns — and every point and the whole grid of the plane follow; doing A then B is written BA, and in general AB ≠ BA, so the order changes the result.

aliases.zh: 矩阵乘法为什么不能交换
aliases.en: why is matrix multiplication not commutative

title.zh: 行列式 · 有符号的面积倍率
title.en: The determinant · a signed area scale factor

description.zh: 矩阵把单位正方形变成一个平行四边形，行列式 det A = ad − bc 就是它的有符号面积：绝对值是面积放大的倍数，负号表示翻面；det = 0 时平面被压成一条线，信息丢失，矩阵没有逆。
description.en: A matrix turns the unit square into a parallelogram, and the determinant det A = ad − bc is its signed area: the size is the area scale factor and a minus sign means the plane is flipped; when det = 0 the plane is squashed onto a line, information is lost and the matrix has no inverse.

aliases.zh: 行列式为 0 是什么意思
aliases.en: what does a zero determinant mean

label.zh: 每个点都是基向量的组合
label.en: Every point is a combination of basis vectors

reason.zh: 点 (x, y) 就是 x 份 e₁ 加 y 份 e₂；线性映射保持这种加法和数乘，所以只要知道 e₁、e₂ 的去向，整个平面的去向就定了。
reason.en: The point (x, y) is x lots of e₁ plus y lots of e₂; a linear map preserves that addition and scaling, so knowing where e₁ and e₂ go fixes where the whole plane goes.

label.zh: 看单位正方形变成了什么
label.en: Watch what the unit square becomes

reason.zh: 两根基向量的像围成一个平行四边形，它的有符号面积就是行列式；两个像共线时面积为 0，平面被压扁。
reason.en: The images of the two basis vectors span a parallelogram whose signed area is the determinant; when the two images line up, the area is 0 and the plane is flattened.

label.zh: 特征值让 A − λI 变奇异

reason.zh: 要找只被拉伸、不被转向的方向，就要求 (A − λI)v = 0 有非零解，也就是 det(A − λI) = 0——特征值正是让这个行列式为零的 λ。
reason.en: Finding a direction that is only stretched, not turned, requires (A − λI)v = 0 to have a nonzero solution, i.e. det(A − λI) = 0 — the eigenvalues are exactly the λ that make this determinant vanish.

reason.zh: 把二元一次方程组的系数排成矩阵，它的行列式就是解法里的 D：D ≠ 0 时两直线交于一点、矩阵可逆；D = 0 时两直线平行或重合，没有唯一解。
reason.en: Arrange a two-equation system’s coefficients as a matrix and its determinant is the D in the solution: D ≠ 0 means the lines meet in one point and the matrix is invertible; D = 0 means parallel or identical lines and no unique solution.

question.zh: 行列式到底表示什么？为什么等于 0 就不可逆？
question.en: What does a determinant actually mean, and why is a zero determinant not invertible?

ask.zh: 单位正方形被矩阵变成了什么形状？它的面积是多少，为什么会有负号？
ask.en: What shape does the matrix turn the unit square into? What is its area, and why can it be negative?

ask.zh: 两根基向量的像共线时，平面会被压成什么？还能从结果唯一找回原来的点吗？
ask.en: If the two basis vectors land on one line, what does the plane collapse to? Can the original point still be recovered uniquely?

reveal.zh: 行列式是矩阵把面积放大的倍数，带符号：负号表示翻面。等于 0 时整个平面被压到一条线（或一点）上，许多不同的点落到同一个结果，信息丢了，自然没有逆矩阵。
reveal.en: The determinant is the factor by which the matrix scales area, with a sign: negative means the plane is flipped. When it is 0 the whole plane is squashed onto a line (or a point), many points share one image, information is lost, and so there is no inverse.
